subject: humanities
passage: Flamenco, the music and dance tradition of Andalusia in southern Spain, draws on several elements that performers combine in shifting proportions: the cante, or song, whose most serious form, the cante jondo, deals with grief, longing, and ______ the toque, the guitar playing that supports and answers the singer; and the palmas, the sharp, rhythmic handclaps with which other performers mark the beat. A performance may also include the baile, or dance, and shouts of encouragement called jaleo. Once confined mainly to private gatherings, flamenco spread to cafes and theaters in the nineteenth century.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

explanation.why: The sentence lists three elements after the colon, and the items themselves contain commas ("the cante, or song, whose most serious form, the cante jondo, …"). When list items contain commas, the items are separated by semicolons, as the later "; and the palmas" shows. The blank marks the end of the first item, so it needs a semicolon.
explanation.A: Incorrect. Without any mark, "loss the toque" runs the first item straight into the second.
explanation.B: Incorrect. The list already uses a semicolon before its last item, and a comma here would make "the toque" look like one more thing the cante jondo deals with, alongside grief, longing, and loss.
explanation.C: Incorrect. A colon has already introduced the list; a second colon in the middle of the list has nothing to introduce.
explanation.D: Correct. The semicolon separates the first item from the second, matching the semicolon used before the third item.
